text:
The electromotive force (e.m.f.) of a cell is defined in terms of which quantities?
A
the energy transferred by the cell in moving charge around the circuit
B
the energy transferred by the cell in moving voltage around the circuit
C
the power transferred by the cell in moving charge around the circuit
D
the power transferred by the cell in moving voltage around the circuit

options.label: A
options.text: the energy transferred by the cell in moving charge around the circuit

options.label: B
options.text: the energy transferred by the cell in moving voltage around the circuit

options.label: C
options.text: the power transferred by the cell in moving charge around the circuit

options.label: D
options.text: the power transferred by the cell in moving voltage around the circuit

subject: Physics
